threshold.method: Youden's J (sensitivity + specificity - 1) maximised on out-of-fold predictions from 5-fold CV on the training set; the test set was not used

calibration.method: CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid', cv=5) wrapped around the selected pipeline
calibration.decision: Calibration not applied: mean CV Brier 0.1525 with it vs 0.1520 without it, so the extra layer did not help.
